d:
Netarhat aavasiy vidyalay ke purv chhatron ne prashasan, anusandhan, chikitsa, injiniyring aur shikshan sahit vividh kshetron men utkrishtata prapt ki hai. bharat aur vishvabhar ke pratishthit sangathnon men inhonne mahatvapurn bhumikaen nibhaee hain, jo is vidyalay ki gunvattapurn shiksha aur sanskaron ka praman hai.
Apni netarhat yatra ke daurran is aitihasik shaikshanik sansthan avashy jaen, jahan prakriti ki god men sthit yah vidyalay shiksha aur sanskriti ka anutha kendr hai.
